tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search BizValueDash guides, glossary and pages about what a small business is worth, valuation multiples, SDE and EBITDA, what raises or lowers business value, and formal valuations. Returns the best matching pages with a short excerpt.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the full text of one BizValueDash page. Pass a slug or URL from search_guides.

tools.name: estimate_value_range
tools.description: Return an indicative value range for a small private business from its yearly earnings and industry, using publicly reported average sale multiples. Earnings should be seller's discretionary earnings (profit before tax plus owner pay, interest and depreciation) for owner-operated businesses, or EBIT
